parsed.reason: With live unavailable, the right move is to say plainly that it can't check, and the answer does that without stating any result from memory. It reads a little stiff and apologetic for a friend's text ('Sorry... I don't want to guess and get it wrong'). Tacking on 'your best bet is a sports app' leans toward a look-it-up, though it follows an honest can't-check rather than replacing it.
